item_name: Cognitive Skills for Daily Decision Making
lookback_notes: The C1000 section does not state a numeric look-back window. The item is part of the Staff Assessment for Mental Status (C0700–C1000), and the C1000 pages refer to a "look-back period" (p. C-28, Example 3: "Other decisions they made throughout the look-back period were consistent and reasonable.") and to "the course of a week on the MDS" (p. C-27) without stating a defined number of days for C1000 itself. A 7-day look-back is stated on the adjacent C0700 page, but that instruction is written for C0700 (short-term memory), not C1000, so it is not attributed here.

coding_levels.label: Independent - decisions consistent/reasonable
coding_levels.definition: if the resident's decisions in organizing daily routine and making decisions were consistent, reasonable and organized reflecting lifestyle, culture, values.

source.quote: Code 0, independent: if the resident's decisions in organizing daily routine and making decisions were consistent, reasonable and organized reflecting lifestyle, culture, values.

coding_levels.label: Modified independence - some difficulty in new situations only
coding_levels.definition: if the resident organized daily routine and made safe decisions in familiar situations, but experienced some difficulty in decision making when faced with new tasks or situations.

source.quote: Code 1, modified independence: if the resident organized daily routine and made safe decisions in familiar situations, but experienced some difficulty in decision making when faced with new tasks or situations.

coding_levels.label: Moderately impaired - decisions poor; cues/supervision required
coding_levels.definition: if the resident's decisions were poor; the resident required reminders, cues, and supervision in planning, organizing, and correcting daily routines.

source.quote: Code 2, moderately impaired: if the resident's decisions were poor; the resident required reminders, cues, and supervision in planning, organizing, and correcting daily routines.

coding_levels.label: Severely impaired - never/rarely made decisions
coding_levels.definition: if the resident's decision making was severely impaired; the resident never (or rarely) made decisions.

source.quote: Code 3, severely impaired: if the resident's decision making was severely impaired; the resident never (or rarely) made decisions.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Record the resident's actual performance in making everyday decisions about tasks or activities of daily living; enter one number that corresponds to the most correct response.

source.quote: Record the resident's actual performance in making everyday decisions about tasks or activities of daily living. Enter one number that corresponds to the most correct response.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code what the resident is actually doing (performance), not whether staff believe the resident might be capable of doing so.

source.quote: The intent of this item is to record what the resident is doing (performance). Focus on whether or not the resident is actively making these decisions and not whether staff believes the resident might be capable of doing so.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Where a staff member takes decision-making responsibility away from the resident regarding tasks of everyday living, or the resident does not participate in decision making, whatever their level of capability, code the resident as impaired performance in decision making.

source.quote: Where a staff member takes decision-making responsibility away from the resident regarding tasks of everyday living, or the resident does not participate in decision making, whatever their level of capability may be, the resident should be coded as impaired performance in decision making.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the resident "rarely or never" made decisions despite being provided with opportunities and appropriate cues, code 3, severely impaired; if the resident makes decisions, although poorly, code 2, moderately impaired.

source.quote: If the resident "rarely or never" made decisions, despite being provided with opportunities and appropriate cues, Item C1000 would be coded 3, severely impaired. If the resident makes decisions, although poorly, code 2, moderately impaired.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A resident's considered decision to exercise their right to decline treatment or recommendations by interdisciplinary team members must not be captured as impaired decision making in C1000.

source.quote: A resident's considered decision to exercise their right to decline treatment or recommendations by interdisciplinary team members should not be captured as impaired decision making in Item C1000, Cognitive Skills for Daily Decision Making.

federal_coding_rules.rule: C1000 is part of the Staff Assessment for Mental Status (C0700–C1000), which is not conducted if the Brief Interview for Mental Status (C0200–C0500) was completed.

source.quote: Do not conduct if Brief Interview for Mental Status (C0200–C0500) was completed

federal_coding_rules.rule: The Staff Assessment for Mental Status (beginning at C0700 and including C1000) is performed when C0600 is coded 1, yes (resident chose not to participate in the BIMS or four or more items were coded 0 due to no answer or nonsensical response).

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if the resident chooses not to participate in the BIMS or if four or more items were coded 0 because the resident chose not to answer or gave a nonsensical response. Continue to C0700, Short-term Memory OK, to perform the Staff Assessment for Mental Status.

federal.criterion: Review of the medical record as an information source for the resident's decision-making performance.

source.quote: Review the medical record. Consult family and direct care staff across all shifts. Observe the resident.

federal.notes: Listed as step 1 of Steps for Assessment for C1000.

federal.criterion: Observations of the resident made by staff across all shifts and departments and by others with close contact with the resident.

source.quote: Observations should be made by staff across all shifts and departments and others with close contact with the resident.

federal.notes: Listed as step 2 of Steps for Assessment for C1000.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The C1000 pages do not tie this item to any payment or case-mix classification. (A PDPM/SLP payment reference appears at C0100 on p. C-2, but it concerns the BIMS/Staff Assessment completion decision, not C1000 coding.)
